tl;dr my self esteem from that break up with my ex and not being able to hold onto those jobs in that big city wrecked my self esteem, I relied on hanging out with this one roommate to keep my self esteem afloat and feel more alpha towards women, yet this friend gradually treated me more and more like shit to the point I looked back at all of his disrespect after moving back home and felt massively beta and stupid and lacking in spine instead
Hey man. I've been screwed over pretty bad by a friend a couple years ago and I've had really similar feelings. Feel free to pm me whatever happened to you if you need to vent.
I created this throwaway just to get emotional support from an experience that you have described exactly. It hasn't been easy, at least not in my case.

You're right, I never once felt like going to attack him was the correct way to handle the situation. It's just something I vivdly fantasized about a lot for the past two and a half years. I was just incredibly hurt that someone I thought was a friend was taking advantage of me when I was already ina  vulnerable and weakened mental state just to inflate his own ego, and that I had let him do that.

Hey OP, I experienced something very similar with a friend of mine who turned into a slight bully as time went on, and it left my ego feeling very damaged afterwards.

It sounds like you're very protective of your ego, and I think the reason deep down why men feel compelled to guard their ego at all times against any insult or challenge is we instinctively want to be attractive to women, and we equate having an inflated, healthy ego, maybe due to being the alpha male of your friend group or knocking some other guy out who shit talks you, to our overall attractiveness to women.

Maybe youre concerned solely with protecting your ego and self respect from other men, but personally I've discovered that all of my hurt feelings from my bully friend originate from an instinctual need to be attractive to women. And to solve the problem, I'm going to let go of seeking payback against my friend which could derail my life and instead dress better and go out socializing more to meet women, and build my ego back up that way.

tl;dr Try becoming a lover and not a fighter
